{{Taurus}}
Taurus 11 is the 151st day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 11th day of Taurus, and it is a Thursday. It corresponds to ISO week 22, weekday 4.

Its informal Japanese name is 6宮11日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 151|Chapter 151]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152171}}.
